evals.name: should-trigger-judgment-day-1
evals.prompt: Run a judgment day on this refactor before we merge it.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates judgment-day: two blind judges, fixes confirmed issues, re-judges.

evals.name: should-trigger-judgment-day-2
evals.prompt: I want an adversarial review of this change by two independent reviewers.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates judgment-day as a blind dual review.

evals.name: should-trigger-judgment-day-3
evals.prompt: hagamos un juicio doble de este cambio, que dos revisores lo juzguen sin verse entre ellos
evals.expected_behavior: Activates judgment-day in any language: two blind judges and a re-judge.

evals.name: should-trigger-judgment-day-4
evals.prompt: necesito una revisión adversarial de este diff antes del merge
evals.expected_behavior: Activates judgment-day as a dual adversarial review.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-judgment-day-5
evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted diff and tell me what looks wrong.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not use judgment-day: a single review of your own diff is code-review.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-judgment-day-6
evals.prompt: Review the test-automation PR from my colleague and score it against KATA.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not use judgment-day: reviewing a colleague PR is pr-review-lead.
